item.title: German Unity Day – Saturday, 3 October 2026
item.description:
German Unity Day – Saturday, 3 October 2026

Tag der Deutschen Einheit is Germany's national day. It marks the moment in 1990 when East and West Germany formally reunified into a single country after decades of division, one of the most significant dates on the German calendar. It's also a nationwide public holiday.

Since it falls on a Saturday this year, closing rules apply, meaning grocery stores and most shops will be closed all day.

Stock up on groceries and anything else you need by Friday!

item.title: Finding housing in Germany can be challenging, especially when you are new to...
item.description:
[Document/Video]

Finding housing in Germany can be challenging, especially when you are new to the system. To support international students, TU Darmstadt is offering online webinars that explain how to search for accommodation, where to look, and what to watch out for during the process.

During the session, you will learn about common housing options, useful platforms, and practical tips for navigating the housing market in Darmstadt.

When: Thursday, 28th September, 4:30 pm (CEST) (16:00)

More information and webinar access:
http://www.tu-darmstadt.de/housing-assist

Nationwide Warning Day, 10 September, 11 a.m.

Germany tests its warning systems today! Expect warning apps to beep, sirens to wail, and test alerts on digital billboards nationwide.

More info: https://verwaltungsportal.hessen.de/en/leistung?leistung_id=B100019_102659338
